subject: Coffee with [SENDER] in NYC - 7th/8th August?
text:

We're building a multimodal AI data development platform - working with frontier teams including Boston Dynamics, Thinking Machine Labs & Onfido - to bring together data governance, annotation, and model evaluation in a single platform. 

We'd love to explore if there's an opportunity to work with Alpha Sense in the near to mid-term - or to simply start a conversation now to build a relationship for the future.

It'd be great to say hello and meet in-person - any chance you're around for a quick coffee?

subject: Training data pipeline for perception model
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded Mytra who was moving from simulation to real-world data collection to train their perception model. At the time they lacked a system to effectively index, auto-label and QA to keep up with the surging training data volume. I wonder if you've encountered similar challenges at [COMPANY]? 

In case Encord is new to you - we help physical AI teams (e.g. Skydio, Zipline, Mytra, etc.) automate their annotation pipelines as they scale. Handful of customers in the space leverage our model-assisted workflow and our labelling editor's support across 2D (image & video) and 3D point cloud data, as a complement to Foxglove.

Keen to hear how you're thinking about your training data as you scale? I'm flexible Tuesdays to Thursdays if you're open to chat.

subject: Data model performance feedback loop
text:
Hi [NAME],

We recently onboarded Entrust (Onfido) who needed to understand failure modes and accelerate time to action to improve data representativeness & label inaccuracy, when the expected margin of error for model prediction is low. With injection attacks becoming more common in the IDV space, I thought solving for model accuracy in high-stake situations might be something on your mind? 

In case Encord is new to you - we support over 200 AI teams to accelerate the annotation to model eval feedback loop. They typically leverage our workflow orchestrator for annotation (auto-labeling, consensus, and human QC/QA) which is integrated with our data and label validation capabilities. We've also built out functionalities around data lineage tracking and secure deployment for teams in regulated environments. 

How are you thinking about the data to model performance feedback loop at [COMPANY]? I'm flexible Tuesday to Thursday if you're open to a chat.

subject: Scaling your data post Series B
text:
Hi [NAME],

Congrats & excited to see your team accelerating autonomous mushroom farm operations! Many ag robotics teams (Bloomfield Robotics, Four Growers, Carbon Robotics) came to us at similar stages when they faced surging data volume as a result of scaling customer deployments, so I wonder if you're encountering/ anticipating similar situations at 4AG? 

In case Encord is new to you - we help over 200 AI teams improve data quality and save time from manual annotation. AgTech teams typically leverage our workflow orchestrator to automate annotation tasks (object detection, segmentation, classification) and track projects & workforces productivity, with the goals of more accurate model prediction for robotic tasks. 

How are you thinking about developing perception models for new customer deployments? Flexible Tuesdays to Thursdays if you're open to a chat.

text:

I lead a Drones / Robotics team here at Encord, working with Helsing, Tekever, Skydio & other leading teams - providing the platform to support Multimodal data annotation & curation - available as a highly secure on-premise deployment. 

Drone teams typically move over to Encord when looking to increase annotation throughput / efficiency whilst maintaining the highest levels of data compliance - so curious to know if this was also something top of mind at [COMPANY]? 

Let me know if it makes sense to chat, happy to share some ideas based on how we've helped similar teams,
